text.autoconfig.simplequalityoflife.opti: Frost Walker Walk on Powder Snow
Allows players wearing Frost Walker boots to walk on powder snow without sinking. Default: true.
Quality of Life
Enable Auto-Walk
Allows automatic walking via keybind. Default: false.
Muted Entity Types
List of entity IDs (e.g. minecraft:cow) whose sounds are silenced. Default: [].
Nametag Mute Suffixes
List of name suffixes. Mobs named with one of these will be silenced. Default: ["_mute", "_shhh"].
Baby Suffixes
Babies named with one of these suffixes will never grow up (e.g., _baby). Default: ["_baby", "_small"].
Feather Falling Protects Farmland
If enabled, players with Feather Falling boots will not trample farmland. Default: true.
Sharpness Cuts Grass
If enabled, Sharpness III+ weapons cut through grass/flowers when attacking entities. Default: true.
Hoe Replanting
Right-click fully grown crops with a hoe to harvest and replant them. Consumes durability. Default: true.
Fill Furnace with Lava
Insert one lava bucket into an empty fuel slot or exchange one leftover bucket. An empty bucket remains in the furnace after burning. Default: true.
Ladder Climbing Speed
Adjusts the vertical speed when climbing ladders. Vanilla default is ~0.2. Default: 0.4. Allowed range: 0.2–0.4.
Fast Ladder Slide
If enabled, allows faster sliding down ladders. Default: true.
Ladder Slide Speed
Adjusts the vertical speed when sliding down ladders. Default: 0.8. Allowed range: 0.15–0.8.
Slide Activation Mode
Determines how ladder sliding is activated (CAMERA = look down + sneak, ALWAYS = look down unless sneaking). Default: "CAMERA".
Vault Cooldown (Days)
Time in Minecraft days until a player can loot a vault again. Default: 100. Allowed range: 1–36500.
Full Durability Bonus
Grants a bonus to mining speed and damage when tools/weapons are near full durability. Default: true.
Durability Threshold (0.8–1.0)
The fraction of durability required to trigger the bonus (e.g., 0.9 for 90%). Default: 0.8. Allowed range: 0.8–1.0.
Bonus Multiplier
The multiplier applied to speed/damage (e.g., 1.15 for +15%). Default: 1.0. Allowed range: 1.0–1.5. Applies to Vanilla and mod tools. 1.0 means no bonus; saved values are retained.
Repairing Keeps Anvil Cost
Repairing or renaming at the anvil without new enchantments does not raise the item's anvil cost. Only enchanting does. Default: true.
Piglins Ignore Gold Trims
Piglins won't attack if you wear armor with gold trims. Default: true. Attacks and container interactions can still anger piglins.
Piglins Ignore Gold Tools
Piglins won't attack if you hold gold tools or weapons. Default: true. Attacks and container interactions can still anger piglins.
Disable Weather (Server)
Stops rain and thunder from occurring and clears active weather. Server-side. Default: false.
Rain Disturbance (Client)

Reduces rain particles and sounds.
100 = All particles/sounds
0 = No particles/sounds (Silent). Default: 20. Allowed range: 0–100.
simplequalityoflife.config.title: Simple Quality of Life — Server settings
text.autoconfig.simplequalityoflife.opti: Manual Crawling
Allow /crawl and the crawl key. The server validates and limits changes. Default: true.
Repeat Vault Rewards
Allow repeat vault rewards after the server cooldown. Disable to retain Vanilla one-time rewards. Default: true.
